Introduction

Inpyo is a South Korean singer and member of the boy group SKYE (formerly IN2IT). In 2016 he participated in the survival show BOYS24. After placing 8th, he debuted as a member of IN2IT on October 26, 2017 with their mini album "Carpe Diem".
